calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS unique_members
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
WHERE s.city = 'Tampere' 
  AND s.store_id < 900  -- exclude web shop and training store
  AND f.member_key IS NOT NULL  -- only members

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN m.member_id END) AS unique_members,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NULL THEN f.receipt_id END) AS non_member_receipts
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON f.member_key = m.member_key
WHERE s.city = 'Tampere' 
  AND s.store_id < 900  -- exclude web shop and training store

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members_with_tampere_home_store
FROM dim_member m
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON m.home_store_id = s.store_id
WHERE s.city = 'Tampere' 
  AND m.is_current = TRUE
  AND s.store_id < 900  -- exclude web shop and training store

calls.statement:
SELECT MAX(calendar_date) AS latest_date, 
       MAX(fiscal_year) AS fiscal_year,
       MAX(fiscal_week) AS fiscal_week
FROM dim_date

-- Find the as-of Sunday for week 53 FY2026/27
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_end_date AS as_of_sunday, 
       DATE_TRUNC('day', CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', (CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', (as_of_sunday AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) - INTERVAL 364 DAY AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) AS DATE) as start_date_for_trailing_52
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_week = 53 AND day_of_week = 7  -- Sunday
LIMIT 1

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_end_date, 
       fiscal_week_end_date - INTERVAL 364 DAY AS start_date_for_trailing_52
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_week = 53 AND day_of_week = 7
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, MAX(fiscal_week_end_date) as week_end
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_week
ORDER BY fiscal_week DESC
LIMIT 5
